title: Authorization for Height and Setback Modifications
previewText:
Within the Special Southern Hunters Point District, for any development or enlargement, the City Planning Commission may modify the regulations set forth in Section 125-30, inclusive, provided the Commission finds that such modifications:

(a) will result in a better distribution of bulk on the zoning lot and will not adversely affect access to light and air for surrounding public access areas, streets and properties

blocks.plainText: Within the Special Southern Hunters Point District, for any development or enlargement, the City Planning Commission may modify the regulations set forth in Section 125-30, inclusive, provided the Commission finds that such modifications:

blocks.html: (a)        will result in a better distribution of bulk on the zoning lot and will not adversely affect access to light and air for surrounding public access areas, streets and properties;
blocks.plainText: (a) will result in a better distribution of bulk on the zoning lot and will not adversely affect access to light and air for surrounding public access areas, streets and properties;

blocks.html: (b)        are consistent with the goals of the Special District to provide flexibility of architectural design and encourage more attractive building forms; and
blocks.plainText: (b) are consistent with the goals of the Special District to provide flexibility of architectural design and encourage more attractive building forms; and

blocks.html: (c)        will result in a development or enlargement that enhances the streetscape and is compatible with development in the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: (c) will result in a development or enlargement that enhances the streetscape and is compatible with development in the surrounding area.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe additional conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects of the development or enlargement on the character of the surrounding area.
